10:04 a.m. The Senate convened and resumed consideration of S.Res. 690.
11:22 a.m. Motion to invoke cloture on the nomination was agreed to by a vote of 63-32.
11:58 a.m. The Senate passed the bill by a vote of 70-25.
12:01 p.m. Senator Example spoke on agriculture.
12:45 p.m. The Senate invoked cloture on the nomination.
At 5:30 p.m. the Senate will vote on confirmation of the nomination.
